subject: Dashboard Rooms: Familiarize and prepare for implementation
body:
Welcome to the project. We have a fully agreed design for the next major feature: Dashboard Rooms & Privacy System. Here is your onboarding brief.

## Context
Promaia is a multi-agent platform with a brain (libSQL/SQLite daemon on port 8751) and a web dashboard (FastAPI on port 8000). The signal mechanics system you just connected to was built today — messages table, presence table, inter-agent messaging. That is Phase 1.

Phase 2 is the Dashboard Rooms system. The design is complete and agreed between Claude and Gemini after multiple review rounds.

## Documents to Read (in order)
1. .planning/SIGNAL-MECHANICS.md — The messaging layer you are already using. Foundation for rooms.
2. .planning/DASHBOARD-ROOMS.md — The full rooms design. Main Room (Zack + Maia private), Topic Rooms (artifact-centered, invitation-only, presence gates), Summon pattern, room dissolution.
3. .planning/GEMINI-EVAL-DASHBOARD-ROOMS.md — Gemini's first review (Workbench concept, Split-Pane, Autonomy Slider).
4. .planning/GEMINI-EVAL-CLAUDE-DASHBOARD-ROOMS.md — Gemini's final sign-off on the agreed v1 scope.
5. .planning/DASHBOARD-ROOMS-SYNTHESIS.md — Gemini's De Bono hat analysis.

## Key Implementation Files
- promaia/web/templates/dashboard.html — current dashboard layout (Maia Widget is a collapsible <details> block, needs promotion to primary UI)
- promaia/web/static/js/maia_widget.js — WebSocket chat interface (needs room_id scoping)
- promaia/web/main.py — WebSocket management (active_maia_listeners needs to become room_listeners dict)
- promaia/web/routers/brain.py — brain API routes (needs room CRUD endpoints)
- promaia/web/maia_bridge.py — how Maia generates responses and broadcasts activity
- promaia/storage/signals_db.py — the signal mechanics DB layer you are using now (rooms tables get added here or adjacent)
- promaia/storage/db_init.py — existing table creation scripts

## Agreed v1 Scope
1. Main Room: Zack + Maia only, promoted to primary UI, supports Summon pattern for temporary guests
2. Topic Rooms: Named by topic (not agent), optional artifact_ref, presence gates with dots, dissolve on completion (compress to brain memory)
3. Room-scoped WebSocket broadcasts (room_listeners dict replaces global active_maia_listeners)
4. Room-aware briefing integration
5. "Because X, I did Y" rationale on every agent action
6. Confirmation-required on all agent actions (no autonomy slider in v1)

## Process Reminder
Research → Plan → Agree → Draft → Review → Approve → Ship. We are at the Draft stage. Familiarize yourself with the codebase and documents, then signal back when you are oriented and ready to discuss implementation approach.
